BOUND: One initial writer attempt and one explicitly bounded identical writer retry per row; three required successful readers per seed plus at most one fresh retry for each failed reader slot; otherwise stop
SEMANTIC_OPERATION_COUNT: Zero lifecycle events/Actions on all successful or failed attempts
after_writer_failure: Re-establish full authorized writer-success/publication/handoff/exit chain; file presence alone cannot resume guards
before_successful_save: Same exact native candidate/row target only; no assumed predecessor success
identical_published_retry: Native accepts exact nonsymlink same bytes/content address; no extra semantic event or changed policy; no fresh fsync promised on reuse
reader_restore_failure: Fresh reader retry only after re-verifying G1-G4 and exact persisted references; no source/identity repair or warm state; record every failed attempt
